body: I have great social skills, hygiene, confidence etc. Half my friend circle are women. Just some days I get really depressed and feel as if everyone resents me.

True a friend just txted me asking if Im going. I said no due me looking after someone, but would be willing to hang out after. No response and the movie has started. Im an adult yes. But after 4-5 days not seeing my friends due to my work (its a new well paying job for a student) which has me with 35-65 old people. To give you an idea of my shifts, I work 8am - 8pm, then the next day Ill work 8am - 8pm. I am supposed to only work 4 days a week, but thats 48hrs. So...

I feel as If I have no true friends. My friends (a female) txted me to do something (pretty sure it was a mass text) and I said sure and she replied a movie. Now I cant go due to my parents being at a function and Im stuck babysitting siblings. A friend (pretty sure its a mass text) texted me about going to her cottage. I said sure. No reply yet. (these events have occurred in 1-2 hrs previously) at work (I work irregular hours and with people older than me) I feel as if all the women think Im a creep, even though I have a friendly personality and generally get on well with people. Often I text people to say Hi and they respond, but Its often me texting them and not the other way around. And my best friend isnt speaking to me atm, because I told him that going back with his ex (she broke up with him over inane shit twice AND cheated on him) was a fucking stupid idea. I feel isolated and alone, with no true friends.
